title: Existence and vanishing noise limit of measure attractors for McKean-Vlasov $p$-Laplacian lattice systems with delay driven by Lévy noise
summary: This paper is concerned with the existence and the limiting behavior of measure attractors of distribution laws of the solution segment process for the McKean-Vlasov stochastic $p$-Laplace lattice system with time delay driven by Lévy noise. The nonlinear drift and diffusion terms are allowed to have superlinear growth. Due to time delay, the Skorohod metric space is employed to describe the trajectories of the solutions with jumps.
